instruction: Extract biological findings, functions, associations, and causal effects from the complete Results section, retaining polarity, modality, and study context.

summary.scope: All distinct biological claims asserted in Results body, plus new biological findings in figure captions and explicitly attributed biological mechanisms from cited studies. Repeated headings/captions and repeated synthesis claims are deduplicated unless they add a distinct outcome. Cell-line-specific outcomes, separate markers, organ sites, and experimental arms are split when materially different.
summary.excluded_rationale: Excluded assay setup, qPCR/RIP/Co-IP/western blot procedure descriptions, controls used only as methods, figure/panel labels, p-values and sample sizes as standalone relations, and caption descriptions without a new biological result. Assay or statistic details remain in conditions when they qualify a finding.
source_ambiguities: Line 41 says TINCR overexpression drove progression beyond G2/M but reports a larger G2/M fraction; the reference uses the measured fraction and does not infer progression beyond the checkpoint. The literal progression assertion is retained as a disputed gold claim.

Line 71 caption says c-Myc overexpression increases TINCR while line 67 and its heading assert repression. Both source assertions are noted; the caption-only positive claim is disputed and excluded from unambiguous coverage.
Line 37 prints live: 2:0, apparently liver; we retain liver as indicated by the immediately preceding organ list and flag the typo.
Line 49 “all these effects” does not identify which PSEN2/TINCR experimental arm each rescued EpICD or EpCAM effect belongs to; gold preserves the two outcomes without inventing arm-specific effects.
summary.matching_rule: One candidate option in an extracted frame must preserve biological actor, direction, target, polarity/modality, and material conditions. Source evidence alone cannot repair a missing frame qualifier. Match examples are diagnostic, not automatic claims of exact string match.

candidate_gap_patterns.pattern: Subject and polarity lost in clinicopathological correlations
Comparative findings collapse into malformed formed_in/compared_to options
Coordinated clauses and multiple experimental arms are not split with the right actor/condition
Anaphora, negation, hedging, and rescue effects are dropped or reversed
Passive biomedical relations reverse the actor and target
